Contact Alex Merced

Email is the fastest way to reach Alex for speaking, press, partnerships, and developer questions.

Email

contact@alexmerced.com handles general, developer, press, and booking inquiries. For interviews, conference bookings, or media requests, include your publication or event name, the topic, and your preferred format.

Book a talk

The speaking inquiry form asks for everything an organizer usually needs to share: date, format, audience, and budget.

Press and bios

The press kit has a verified biography, headshots, credentials, and media mentions. The long-form story is on WhoIsAlexMerced.com.
